feature_contract.goal: Reduce synchronous D3D9 tracked-state reads during active occlusion queries and stop inactive Present instrumentation overhead without changing stereo replay, diagnostic accuracy or failure isolation.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R26/R27 source-only CPU fast paths and registered negative checks; no HUD, SkyGlow, transport fence/interop, host, DX11/DXVK, or FFB changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Before this source change R26 unconditionally requested all four render states per active occlusion draw, even after a writable color/depth state disproved query-only; disabled VR telemetry still made two QPC calls and floating-point Present statistics each frame. Early proof saves three/two/one tracked reads for color-writing/depth-writing/stencil-disabled cases and bypasses two QPC calls while telemetry is disabled. The number of saved calls is source-derived, not a measured Quest3 FPS improvement.
trace_stages: Game active occlusion query reaches R26 single-execution gate before normal R23 stereo replay, requiring four write-state predicates.
Fail-closed tracked render-state readers and short-circuit decisions reject color/depth writers early and retain all live checks for potentially writable stencil.
R27 wraps actual game Present through R23 and samples pacing only while VRTelemetry is enabled, resetting measurement baselines on disable and rearming cleanly on enable.
Windows x86 game/hook and x64 host/package exact-SHA integrated Actions must preserve R26 draw and R27 Present ABI and working stereo paths.
subcomponents: Short-circuit D3D9/R22 tracked getter chain at first conclusive color/depth write, and avoid irrelevant stencil write-mask read when stencil testing disabled.
Keep conservative state-read failures, readable stencil write-mask veto, unchanged underlying R23 draw and Present hook forwarding.
Remove disabled R27 QPC/double accumulation while invalidating old 5s pacing and thread CPU baselines only on transition, resuming correct first-frame counters.
Registered positive/negative source and branch-policy regression across 16 writer predicates, getter failures, destructive mutations, and integrated Win32 Gates.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Known color/depth writing draw fails fast before further tracked driver getters; fully read write-free query draws execute once exactly as before.

Disabled VRTelemetry forwards original Present without QPC; transitions reset stale pacing; all relevant unavailable render-state reads reject query-only drawing and telemetry-on sampling retains QPC.
Exact material commit passes new mutation verifier and full Win32 DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation and applicable Full Source Impact Gates.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R26TrackedOcclusionDrawIsWriteFree always reads COLORWRITEENABLE/ZWRITEENABLE/STENCILENABLE/STENCILWRITEMASK, even after a previous predicate proves a writer; PresentDestR27 always calls QPC twice regardless of Settings::VRTelemetry.
diagnosis.root_cause: Boolean filtering occurs only after four tracked reads; R27 optional telemetry flag gates logs but not unconditional QPC and FP-statistics collection.
source_trace: ActiveOcclusionQueries >0 invokes R26GuardTrackedOcclusion before ordinary R23 replay.
R26 write-free classification reads R22 tracked states and bypasses R23 only if no color/depth/stencil output can be modified.
R27 Present hook wraps R23 actual Present and previously performs QPC and double-statistics even without active diagnostic use.
alternatives_rejected: Blindly treating any active occlusion query as write-free can skip required stereo color/depth draw.
Skipping required mask on stencil-enabled writes risks losing correct stencil coverage.
Zeroing diagnostic baselines each disabled frame creates avoidable 2.5KB TLS window initialization overhead.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Early short circuits preserve source state-read fail-closed behavior for consulted predicates; disabled Present hook calls its original lower hook and resets pacing only on enabled-to-disabled transition.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: CI-registered verifier enumerates 16 render state tuples, every actually consulted getter failure and ten destructive source mutations; Quest3 runtime not executed.
diagnosis.failed_step: R26 checker destructive mutation incorrectly matched thread_local initialization rather than transition assignment
diagnosis.repair: Anchor the disabled transition mutation with its unique 20-space indentation, so the verifier fails on removed edge-trigger reset; negative assertions remain strict. Original C++ material unchanged.

required: DX9Ex Full Source Impact Review where triggered
